label: Inventory
description: One Square location shares its stock with this store. Linked items are found by SKU: choose Match products in the Actions menu, check the list under Products → Square stock, and start the items there. From then on a sale, a delivery or a recount on either side reaches the other within about a minute. Leave the location empty if your Square account has one location. The Swell location is only for stores that keep stock by location: leave it empty to use the store's stock as a whole.

modal.title: Match products
modal.description: Reads the items of your Square catalog and looks for a Swell product or variant with the same SKU. Nothing is changed in Square, and no stock moves: the pairs are listed under Products → Square stock, where you start them. Run it again after adding products or SKUs.
